title: 第7章 紫阳城坊市第8章 钱塘郡许家
lines: 紫阳郡除了那座设立于紫阳宗门内的小坊市外，另有一处大的坊市位于郡城中。
此处管理权虽然仍然归紫阳宗所有，但紫阳宗并不干涉过多的经营活动，只是每月收取定额的税费而已。
故而此处聚集了紫阳郡大量的中小门派、修仙家族以及无数的散修，好生兴旺。
李卓阳从紫阳仙山来到此处时，已经接近中午，虽然他肉身强大，不惧这点赶路的辛苦，但是着实有些浪费时间。
走入坊市，李卓阳发现这里占地足有数百亩之广，其中林立着大大小小的商铺多达上百家！
这些商铺不仅数量众多，而且每一家的规模都相当宏大，远远超出了李卓阳在紫阳宗内的那间杂货铺。
坊市中心位置，李卓阳看到了一座装饰得极为奢华富丽堂皇的商铺。
商铺大门之上，熠熠生辉的招牌上赫然书写着三个苍劲有力的大字——“百宝阁”！
“上仙，里面请，想要买点什么？”李卓阳刚一走进，门口的杂役小哥儿很热情地招呼道。
通过称呼，李卓阳判断出这小哥儿不是修士，否则肯定会称上一句道友的。
“你们店铺，可收灵矿？”
“灵矿？难道上仙有灵矿出售？”小哥儿看着李卓阳年纪轻轻地，似乎不太敢相信的样子。
“正是。”
“那上仙请里面坐，我去请负责鉴别灵矿的掌柜大人出来。”说着，将李卓阳引入一间茶室，倒上茶水后，便退步离去。
李卓阳抿了一口茶，感觉味道还算不错，但却无半分灵气波动，显然是凡人饮用的普通茶叶而已。
这茶叶也有普通茶和灵茶之分，灵茶顾名思义，就是蕴含有灵气的茶叶。
李卓阳此时一心追求修炼，对不含灵气之物没有半点兴趣，便将茶杯放了下来。
过了片刻，只见一个留着短须的中年男子走了出来，浑身散发的灵气波动大概有炼气八层左右。
“见过小兄弟，老夫姓黄，忝为百宝阁的掌柜，听说小兄弟是来卖灵矿的？”
“正是。”
“不知是何灵矿，能否给在下鉴别一番？”
“自然可以。”说完，李卓阳拿出了一块紫阳石，放到了二人之间的茶几上。
“这是咱们紫阳郡特有的紫阳石，炼制法器的材料，成色不错。”那黄掌柜接着说道：“不知小兄弟手中是否还有？”
“有！”李卓阳肯定地答复道。
“只是不知贵店的收购价是几何？”李卓阳又朝掌柜问道。
“紫阳石在本郡乃常见之灵材，价格很透明，一律是十五块下品灵石一块。”
来之前李卓阳也曾打听过，故而对这个价格也没起什么心思，只是默默地点点头。
“小兄弟手中有多少紫阳石？”黄掌柜见李卓阳一副高深莫测的样子，又换了种问法。
李卓阳默不作声，将储物袋的紫阳石全部移了出来。
这间密室顿时被紫色光晕映照满屋。
“没想到小兄弟居然有如此身家。”黄掌柜原本以为李卓阳只是个普通散修，身上能有个三五块就不错了，没想到出手竟然就是近百颗。
“都是家中长辈的收藏而已。”李卓阳淡淡说道。
他知道自己年轻，怕引起别人的觊觎，故意将紫阳石说成是家中长辈的。
“原来如此，道友权且再饮一杯茶，在下需将紫阳石拿去查验。”他听出了李卓阳的话中之意，也收去了心中原本的轻视之意，将称呼也从小兄弟改为了道友。
黄掌柜说完见李卓阳并无反对之意，便招呼杂役更换了茶水，然后拿着紫阳石进入了内室。
content_en:
In addition to the small city established in Ziyang Sect, Ziyang County also has a large city located in the county.
Although the management rights here still belong to the Ziyang Sect, the Ziyang Sect does not interfere with too many business activities and only collects a fixed amount of taxes and fees every month.
Therefore, a large number of small and medium-sized sects, cultivating families, and countless casual cultivators from Ziyang County gathered here, making them prosperous.
When Li Zhuoyang arrived here from Ziyang Fairy Mountain, it was already close to noon. Although his body was strong and he was not afraid of the hardship of traveling, it was a waste of time.
Walking into Fangshi, Li Zhuoyang found that it covers an area of ​​hundreds of acres, with hundreds of shops of various sizes!
Not only are these shops numerous in number, but each one is quite large in scale, far exceeding Li Zhuoyang's grocery store in Ziyang Sect.
In the center of the square, Li Zhuoyang saw an extremely luxurious and magnificent shop.
Above the door of the shop, three vigorous and powerful characters are written on the shining signboard - "Baibao Pavilion"!
"Shangxian, please come inside. What do you want to buy?" As soon as Li Zhuoyang walked in, the handyman at the door greeted him warmly.
Through the title, Li Zhuoyang judged that this young man was not a monk, otherwise he would have called him a fellow Taoist.
"Can your store collect spiritual minerals?"
"Spirit Mine? Is there a Spirit Mine for sale in Shangxian?" The little brother looked at Li Zhuoyang's young age and seemed to be in disbelief.
"Exactly."
"Then please sit inside, Shangxian. I'll ask the shopkeeper responsible for identifying the spiritual mines to come out." After saying that, he introduced Li Zhuoyang into a tea room, poured tea, and then stepped back and left.
Li Zhuoyang took a sip of the tea and felt that the taste was pretty good, but there was no spiritual energy fluctuation at all. It was obviously just ordinary tea drunk by mortals.
This tea is also divided into ordinary tea and spiritual tea. As the name suggests, spiritual tea is tea that contains spiritual energy.
At this time, Li Zhuoyang was focused on pursuing cultivation and had no interest in anything that did not contain spiritual energy, so he put down the teacup.
After a while, a middle-aged man with a short beard walked out. The spiritual energy fluctuations emanating from his body were about the eighth level of Qi Refining.
"I have met my little brother. My surname is Huang. I am the shopkeeper of Baibao Pavilion. I heard that my little brother is here to sell spiritual minerals?"
"Exactly."
"I don't know if it's He Ling Mine. Can you help me identify it?"
"Of course you can." After saying that, Li Zhuoyang took out a purple sun stone and placed it on the coffee table between the two of them.
"This is Ziyang Stone unique to our Ziyang County. It is a material for refining magical weapons. It is of good quality." Shopkeeper Huang continued: "I wonder if my little brother still has it in his hands?"
"Yes!" Li Zhuoyang replied affirmatively.
"I just don't know what the purchase price of your store is?" Li Zhuoyang asked the shopkeeper again.
"Purple Yang Stone is a common spiritual material in this county. The price is very transparent. It is always 15 yuan for a low-grade spiritual stone."
Li Zhuoyang had inquired about it before coming here, so he didn't think much about the price and just nodded silently.
"How many Purple Sunstones do you have in your hands?" Shopkeeper Huang changed his question when he saw Li Zhuoyang's enigmatic look.
Li Zhuoyang remained silent and removed all the purple sun stones from the storage bag.
The secret room was suddenly filled with a purple halo.
"I didn't expect that little brother would have such a fortune." Shopkeeper Huang originally thought that Li Zhuoyang was just an ordinary cultivator, and it would be good to have three or five yuan on him, but he didn't expect that he had nearly a hundred.
"They are just collections of the elders in the family." Li Zhuoyang said lightly.
He knew that he was young and was afraid of arousing the covetousness of others, so he deliberately said that the Ziyang Stone belonged to an elder in the family.
"I see, fellow Taoist, please have another cup of tea. I need to take the purple sun stone for inspection." He heard the meaning of Li Zhuoyang's words, and he also put away the original contempt in his heart, and changed his title from little brother to fellow Taoist.
After speaking, shopkeeper Huang saw that Li Zhuoyang had no objection, so he asked the servants to change the tea, and then entered the inner room with the Ziyang Stone.
